description: This file defines an internal readonly struct 'InvokableMethodProxyBaseId' used in the Orleans code generator. It encapsulates information identifying a proxy base type, including whether it is an extension, and provides methods for equality comparison, string representation, and constructing components related to proxy class naming.

classes.name: InvokableMethodProxyBaseId
classes.description: An internal readonly struct that uniquely identifies a proxy base type for code generation purposes, including extension status and class name components.

methods.name: InvokableMethodProxyBaseId
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the struct with a type symbol and extension flag, asserting that the type is an original definition and creating alias components accordingly.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Method to determine equality based on proxy base type and extension status.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the extension flag and proxy base type.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns the generated class name component as a string representation.
